description: Cables sous-Marins en Corse is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. À l’échelle de la Corse, les jeux de données se concentrent sur les câbles sous-marins qui connectent l’île au continent. Ils permettent d’étudier les infrastructures numériques locales et leur rôle dans la connectivité de la région. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Digital and Telecommunications. Its keywords are câbles, câbles sous -marins, cable telecommunication sous marin. The portal shows 7 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-04-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
